title: LUMA: Personal AI Desktop Assistant
short_desc: My personal AI assistant for the desktop. Say "Luma" to wake it, then chat, check the news and markets, use the camera, run commands or play music — all in one app.
blueprint_desc: LUMA has five tools on a bar at the bottom of the screen: a live news and markets feed, a chat window (by voice or text), a camera view, a command terminal and a music player connected to Spotify. It runs on my own computer rather than in the cloud, and will eventually use LUMA Brain — the language model I am building myself. The code is private for now.
tech_notes: The frontend is a PyQt6 desktop app built around a central animated core and five modules on a bottom dock: World Feed (live TV stream, market ticker and chart, top story and headlines), Chat (voice or text, with draggable glass-style panels), Optic (live camera view), Terminal (Luma's own commands and skills) and Music (Spotify now-playing and playback control). Replies come from a local model via Ollama today; the long-term plan is to swap in LUMA Brain, a small language model I am building from scratch and training on my own data and Luma's tools. The source code is currently private.
